title: SUP-301: checkout failures after lunchtime release
body: Opened 14:06 UTC by merchant support, ap-south-1. Several merchants report checkout payment failures beginning around 14:04. On-call handoff at 14:05 describes increased payment-client connection acquisition wait and acquire-timeout messages from checkout-api. The current payment-api handoff says dispatched authorizations are completing normally. Impact count and live telemetry remain unverified.
